name: My Man Can
overview: Moj Dragi Zmore is a show where women call the shots. Four women competing for a cash prize wager on their men's abilities at the poker table. Convinced that their partner is the smartest, fittest, and strongest, the women place bets on intriguing challenges, while the men do their utmost to live up to the wager—with their self-confidence, strength, or endurance literally on the line.
